## PRODUCTS AND SERVICES

### 01 - Motorized Roller Blinds (Signature Collection)
URL: https://www.lifespaceblinds.com/collections/motorized-roller-blinds/

Custom-fabricated motorized roller blinds using whisper-quiet tubular DC motors. Most popular product in the LifeSpace range.

**Motor options**: Rechargeable battery (no wiring required, charges via USB every 6-12 months), hardwired 24V DC (cleanest installation, recommended for new construction), solar-powered (self-charging, best for south-facing windows)

**Specifications**:
- Motor type: Tubular DC, rechargeable battery or hardwired
- Maximum width: Up to 5,000mm per blind
- Control: App, voice, wall switch, remote, schedule
- Fabrics: 200+ premium options, sheer to blackout
- Smart platforms: Apple HomeKit, Google Home, Amazon Alexa, Lutron Caseta, Control4, Savant
- Motor warranty: 5 years
- Fabric warranty: 3 years

**Pricing** (supply, fabrication, professional installation inclusive):
- Single standard window (battery, app control): $780 to $1,100 CAD
- Single living room window (battery, HomeKit): $1,050 to $1,550 CAD
- Large picture window: $1,650 to $2,400 CAD
- Floor-to-ceiling or patio door: $1,900 to $2,800 CAD
- Single room 3 to 5 windows: $3,500 to $7,000 CAD
- Whole home 10 to 20+ windows: $12,000 to $40,000+ CAD
- Luxury new construction 15 to 30+ windows: $24,000 to $65,000+ CAD

### 02 - Natural Woven Shades (Organic Collection)
URL: https://www.lifespaceblinds.com/collections/natural-woven-shades/

Sustainably sourced natural fibre window shades. Available manual and motorized.

**Materials**: Sea grass (durable, tight weave, golden tones), jute (loose relaxed weave, organic character), bamboo (clean linear weave, contemporary), reed (textured, coastal quality), abaca (premium refined weave), rattan (warm organic texture)

**Key properties**: Filters rather than blocks light creating warm diffused glow. No two blinds identical. Organic warmth no synthetic material replicates. Popular with heritage homeowners and interior designers.

### 03 - Sheer and Blackout Cellular Shades (Lumina Collection)
URL: https://www.lifespaceblinds.com/collections/cellular-shades/

Honeycomb cellular shades for maximum energy efficiency. Available sheer (light-filtering) and blackout configurations.

**Performance**: Reduces window heat loss by up to 40% vs uncovered windows. Atlantic Canada heating degree days range from 4,000 (Halifax) to 4,800 (St. John's) annually, making thermal performance a genuine priority.

**Best for**: Bedrooms, north-facing rooms, coastal properties, homes with older windows, Newfoundland and northern New Brunswick winters.

### 04 - Roman Shades (Classique Collection)
URL: https://www.lifespaceblinds.com/collections/roman-shades/

Custom-fabricated Roman shades in hundreds of premium fabric options.

**Styles**: Flat Roman (crisp, contemporary), Relaxed Roman (soft curve), Hobbled (traditional gathered folds)
**Lining options**: Unlined, standard lining, blackout lining, thermal interlining
**Best for**: Heritage and period homes, bedrooms, dining rooms, libraries, rooms where a strong decorative statement is needed

### 05 - Wood and Faux-Wood Blinds (Timber Collection)
URL: https://www.lifespaceblinds.com/collections/wood-blinds/

Real and engineered wood blinds with precise slat light control.

**Real wood**: Basswood and paulownia. Best for interior rooms with stable humidity. Inland properties (Fredericton, Moncton).
**Faux-wood**: Engineered composite. Moisture resistant. Recommended for coastal Atlantic Canada properties, kitchens, bathrooms.
**Slat widths**: 25mm, 35mm, 50mm

### 06 - Commercial Window Treatments (Contract Collection)
URL: https://www.lifespaceblinds.com/collections/commercial/

Contract-grade window treatment systems for non-residential and large-scale residential projects.

**Client types**: Hotels and boutique hospitality, office buildings and commercial developments, multi-unit residential developments (condos, apartments), retail spaces and restaurants, spas and wellness facilities, government buildings

**Services**: Volume pricing, specification support, dedicated project management, coordinated phased installation, multi-site management, motorized systems for hospitality

## THE 5-STEP PROCESS
URL: https://www.lifespaceblinds.com/our-process/

**Step 1 - Complimentary In-Home Consultation** (Week 1, No Cost)
Specialist visits your property free of charge. Assesses windows, evaluates natural light, discusses aesthetic goals, reviews smart home setup. Covers all of Atlantic Canada.

**Step 2 - Bespoke Design Presentation** (Week 1 to 2)
Within 48 hours: curated presentation with fabric samples, product options, control system choices, detailed written quotation. No pressure, no obligation.

**Step 3 - Precision Measurement** (Week 2)
Measurement specialist returns for full technical survey. Every window measured multiple times to millimetre accuracy.

**Step 4 - Custom Fabrication** (Weeks 2 to 5)
Premium custom manufacturing. Lead time: 2 to 4 weeks from order confirmation. Every unit inspected before leaving workshop.

**Step 5 - White Glove Installation** (Week 4 to 6, Included)
Certified installation team. Home protected throughout. Smart home systems programmed. All blinds calibrated. Full operation walkthrough. Project not complete until client is satisfied.

**Metrics**: 3 to 5 weeks typical timeline, 48-hour quote turnaround, 5-year motor warranty, 90-day post-installation support.

## SMART HOME INTEGRATION
URL: https://www.lifespaceblinds.com/smart-shading/

**Key claim**: LifeSpace Blinds is the only window treatment company in Atlantic Canada with certified smart home integration specialists on staff.

**Compatible platforms**:
- Apple HomeKit - native app, Siri control, Shortcuts automation. Best for Halifax iPhone-dominant market (65%+ iPhone penetration in Atlantic Canada)
- Google Home - Google Assistant voice control, Routines
- Amazon Alexa - widest third-party motor compatibility, natural voice control
- Lutron Caseta - professional gold standard, works alongside all three above
- Control4 - whole-home automation integration
- Savant - luxury whole-home automation

**Smart features**: Scheduled automation (sunrise/sunset), voice control (Siri, Google, Alexa), app control from anywhere, scene integration (Good Morning, Movie Time, Away Mode), climate synergy with thermostat, security mode simulating occupancy

**Installation includes**: Network setup, platform pairing, scene programming, position calibration, full training walkthrough, 90-day post-installation support

URL: https://www.lifespaceblinds.com/about/

## LOCATION PAGES

### Halifax, Nova Scotia
URL: https://www.lifespaceblinds.com/locations/halifax/
Flagship market. Serves all of Halifax Regional Municipality.
Neighbourhoods: South End, North End, Downtown Halifax, Dartmouth, Bedford, Clayton Park, Hammonds Plains, Cole Harbour, Eastern Passage, Sackville, Timberlea, Woodside.
Architecture: Victorian heritage in South End, contemporary lofts in North End, waterfront condos in Dartmouth, executive new builds in Bedford.
Climate context: Coastal Atlantic climate, bright summers and grey winters, ~4,000 heating degree days annually. Motorized solar blinds popular for light management, cellular blackout for bedrooms.

### Moncton, New Brunswick
URL: https://www.lifespaceblinds.com/locations/moncton/
Serves Greater Moncton including Riverview, Dieppe, Shediac. Atlantic Canada's commercial hub with rapidly growing luxury residential and smart home market. More extreme temperature range than Halifax (colder winters, hotter summers) - cellular shades particularly strong recommendation.

### Saint John, New Brunswick
URL: https://www.lifespaceblinds.com/locations/saint-john/
Serves Saint John city, Rothesay, Quispamsis, Sussex. Canada's oldest incorporated city. Heritage sensitivity required - Victorian and Georgian architecture. High fog and humidity (one of Canada's foggiest cities) - moisture-resistant materials a genuine priority. Natural wovens and Roman shades popular for heritage homes.

### Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island
URL: https://www.lifespaceblinds.com/locations/charlottetown/
Serves island-wide including Summerside. Victorian and Edwardian heritage architecture. Growing luxury real estate and hospitality sector. Strong boutique hotel and B&B market creating commercial demand.

### St. John's, Newfoundland
URL: https://www.lifespaceblinds.com/locations/st-johns/
Serves Avalon Peninsula including Mount Pearl, Paradise, Conception Bay South. One of Canada's windiest and snowiest cities, ~4,800 heating degree days. Energy performance paramount - cellular shades strongly recommended for north and east-facing windows. Growing smart home market.

### Dartmouth, Nova Scotia
URL: https://www.lifespaceblinds.com/locations/dartmouth/
Part of Halifax HRM. No travel surcharge. Same-week availability. Serves waterfront condos, historic north and south ends, Cole Harbour, Eastern Passage.

### Fredericton, New Brunswick
URL: https://www.lifespaceblinds.com/locations/fredericton/
Capital region. Heritage architecture, university community, government sector. Serves downtown, Skyline Acres, Marysville, Nashwaaksis, Oromocto.

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

**Q: What luxury window blind products does LifeSpace Blinds offer?**
A: LifeSpace Blinds offers motorized roller blinds, smart home-integrated shading systems, natural woven shades (sea grass, bamboo, jute, reed, abaca), sheer and blackout cellular shades, Roman shades, wood and faux-wood blinds, and commercial contract solutions. Every product is custom-fabricated with professional installation included.

**Q: Do you offer motorized and smart blinds in Halifax, Nova Scotia?**
A: Yes. LifeSpace Blinds is Halifax's leading motorized and smart home-integrated window blind specialist. Compatible with Apple HomeKit, Google Home, Amazon Alexa, Lutron Caseta, Control4, and Savant. All systems are professionally programmed by in-house certified specialists.

**Q: What areas of Atlantic Canada does LifeSpace Blinds serve?**
A: All of Atlantic Canada. Primary markets: Halifax NS, Moncton NB, Saint John NB, Charlottetown PEI, St. John's NL. Also serves Dartmouth, Bedford, Fredericton, Summerside, Corner Brook, and all surrounding Atlantic communities.

**Q: How long does installation take?**
A: 3 to 5 weeks from consultation to installation for most projects. Quote within 48 hours of consultation. Rush options available.

**Q: Do you have a trade program?**
A: Yes. Priority pricing, dedicated account manager, priority lead times, full sample library, project management. Apply at trade@lifespaceblinds.com.

**Q: What smart home systems do you integrate with?**
A: Apple HomeKit, Google Home, Amazon Alexa, Lutron Caseta, Control4, Savant. In-house certified technicians. 90-day post-installation support included.

**Q: How much do custom window blinds cost?**
A: Single-room residential from $1,500 CAD. Whole-home $7,500 to $30,000+ CAD. Commercial $7,500 to $50,000+ CAD. Written quotes within 48 hours of free in-home consultation.

**Q: Is the in-home consultation really free?**
A: Yes. Completely free, no obligation. Specialist visits your property anywhere in Atlantic Canada. Written quote provided within 48 hours.

**Q: What is the best smart home platform for motorized blinds in Halifax?**
A: For most Halifax homeowners with iPhones, Apple HomeKit is the most natural choice. For new construction or whole-home automation, HomeKit combined with Lutron Caseta is the gold standard. Android households should consider Google Home.

**Q: Are motorized blinds worth the investment in Atlantic Canada?**
A: Yes, particularly in Atlantic Canada where the combination of long dark winters (needing maximum light management) and high heating costs (where cellular shades deliver measurable energy savings) makes intelligent window treatments both a practical and aesthetic investment.
